_comment: Proven authors the feeder follows skill by skill: every SKILL.md folder in the original repos they own is a candidate, admitted once it shows real use (see MIN_INSTALLS_AUTHOR in feeder.py). Verified via the GitHub API on every run; a login that no longer exists is dropped silently. `skip`: skills that clear the numbers but aren't a fit for a normal AI user's short list, each with the reason.

skip.vercel-labs/skills/find-skills: finds and installs skills — the job Skillproof itself does
skip.mattpocock/skills/setup-matt-pocock-skil: sets up one author's pack, not a skill for your own work
skip.mattpocock/skills/grilling: installed together with grill-me, which calls it
skip.mattpocock/skills/grill-with-docs: a twin of grill-me that also writes project docs
skip.mattpocock/skills/ask-matt: answers as one named person, not a general skill
skip.vercel-labs/agent-browser/agent-browser: needs a separate browser program installed first
skip.pbakaus/impeccable/impeccable: downloads and runs a program on first use
skip.anthropics/skills/skill-creator: for people building skills, and runs scripts and one app's tools
skip.obra/superpowers/using-superpowers: sets up one author's pack, not a skill for your own work
